message.content:
Below is a general recipe you can adapt to whatever comment‑retrieval service you’re working against.  
If you already have a **`delta_key`** (your personal access token), most APIs will let you pass it either:

| Method | Typical place to put the key |
|--------|-----------------------------|
| Query parameter | `https://api.yourservice.com/v1/comments?domain=apple.com&apikey={DELTA_KEY}` |
| Header | `Authorization: Bearer {DELTA_KEY}` |

---

### Step‑by‑step example (using cURL)

```bash
curl -s \
     -H "Accept: application/json" \                     # optional – tells server you expect JSON
     -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_DELTA_KEY_HERE" \   # <-- replace with your real key
     "https://api.yourservice.com/v1/comments?domain=apple.com"
```

*Replace `YOUR_DELTA_KEY_HERE` with the actual value you received.*

#### What each part does

| Part | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `-s` | Silent mode – suppress progress meter so only output shows up |
| `-H "Accept: application/json"` | Informs the server you’d prefer JSON back (most services return JSON anyway) |
| `-H "Authorization: Bearer …"` | Sends your key securely via the Authorization header |
| `"…/v1/comments?domain=apple.com"` | Endpoint + query string specifying the target domain |

---

### If the API expects the key in the body instead

Some endpoints accept POST requests where the payload contains both the key *and* the domain:

```json
{
    "domain": "apple.com",
    "auth_token": "YOUR_DELTA_KEY_HERE"
}
```

Send it like this:

```bash
curl -X POST \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"domain":"apple.com","auth_token":"YOUR_DELTA_KEY"}' \
     https://api.yourservice.com/v1/getComments
```

---

### Common pitfalls & troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
|---------|--------------|-----|
| `401 Unauthorized` | Wrong/missing key | Double‑check spelling, case sensitivity, expiration |
| `404 Not Found` | Incorrect endpoint path | Verify base URL (`https://api.yourservice.com`) and version (`v1`, `v2`,…) |
| Empty array returned | No comments recorded yet | Confirm that the domain actually has stored comments in the system |
| Rate limit exceeded | Too many calls in short time | Add delays between requests or contact support for higher quota |

---

### Quick sanity check in JavaScript (Node.js)

```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');

async function getAppleComments() {
  const url = new URL('https://api.yourservice.com/v1/comments');
  url.searchParams.append('domain', 'apple.com');

  const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
    headers: {
      Accept: 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.DELTA_KEY}`
    }
  });

  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${res.status}`);
  const data = await res.json();
  console.log(data);
}

getAppleComments().catch(console.error);
```

Just set the environment variable `DELTA_KEY` to your secret before running.

---

Feel free to plug in the exact host name, path, and authentication style from your own provider’s docs—everything else stays the same. Happy coding!
